plate.title: B06.B · Full interior ornament and articulated growth
plate.description: The fine reading has a substantial interior silhouette: a repeated flower, fan, leaf panel or connected course blossom. Actual parent ports justify its placement; veins and nested contours articulate the large motif instead of substituting sparse tiny marks for detail. The retained lattice remains the placement and flow scaffold.
